Subject: Mutual action plan — credential pathways & peering timeline

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — as discussed we've put together a lightweight MAP focused on the POC environment handoff so we can get you running on a production-like testbed in the next two weeks. Attached is a draft (MAP-draft-v1.pdf) and a network POA diagram.

Top-level asks for Cyclone to confirm so Redwood can finalize provisioning:  
- Org setup: name of the tenant you want us to seed (if different from "Cyclone-Stage") and admin contact.
- API credentials: agree on ephemeral API key flow vs. long-lived test key (we recommend ephemeral for security).
- IP allowlist: provide CIDR(s) for your outbound NATs to allow our callbacks and healthchecks.
- VPC peering: confirm whether you will peer to our VPC or prefer Transit/PrivateLink; include a target route table id if peering.

Proposed timeline (high-level):
1) Confirm items above by Friday 2027-04-30
2) Redwood seeds tenant + issues test ephemeral keys by Mon 2027-05-03
3) Connectivity verification + synthetic load by Wed 2027-05-05
4) Demo & acceptance window Thu 2027-05-06 — candidate close for POC runway

If you want to shift the dates, call it out and we'll adapt. If security needs an evidence pack (SOC2 excerpts, data flow diagram), flag it and Jordan will attach the pack.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Solutions & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (application/pdf), poa_network_diagram.png (image/png)

Alex — quick note on the technical mechanics so you have what security asked for:  
- Ephemeral API keys: we issue a short-lived token (default TTL 15m) and provide a refresh endpoint via our SDK. The SDK uses the seed client credential to request refresh tokens; we can rotate seed credentials every 7 days for the POC.
- Rotation window options: 15m, 1h, or 4h. Recommend 15m for high-security evals.
- Logs/retention: request audit logs (who/what/when) are stored for 30 days by default; system metrics and traces are 7 days. We can provide a 90-day retention add-on if needed (commercial).
- IP allowlist: to avoid surprises, use these destinations for allowlist on your firewall (outbound from your VPC to Redwood): 52.36.120.0/22, 34.203.176.0/22, and the peering CIDR we'll exchange during the VPC setup.

Test checklist for connectivity (what we'll run once you peer and allowlist):  
1) TCP handshake and BGP route verification (if peering)
2) API key exchange + SDK refresh test
3) 50 concurrent inference connections at target sequence lengths
4) End-to-end latency smoke test (95th percentile under target SLA)

I've attached a one-page evidence summary in the shared MAP link; will drop a PDF to the HubSpot record as well. If you want to review the seed-credential rotation flow, I can share a quick Postman collection.

—Jordan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
